agentTraceBlock.title: Agent Trace 1
agentTraceBlock.description: A local, turn-aware viewer for agent messages, tool calls, and results from a real JSON payload.
agentTraceBlock.guidanceBody: Pass a DSH-style event log, a { events } or { messages } envelope, or a simple role/content array through data. The built-in upload control reads JSON only in the browser; use onDataChange when the host needs to own the imported payload.
